Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: TWO full-body pixel-art battle sprites in exactly 2 columns x 1 row, genuine transparent background. Image 1 is the SAME young male hero Hunapu in his existing Warrior form: preserve his recognisable youthful face, warm tan skin, short side-swept BLUE hair and athletic proportions. Image 2 is the exact NEW SWORD DESIGN reference. Create his advanced Dawn Warrior form, a clear upgrade of this same man, not a different armored person. Outfit upgraded but practical and slim: broader pale ice-blue segmented shoulder armor, light-blue chest armor over a deep navy fitted tunic, navy split short coat/tassets with pale-blue lining, navy forearm guards and navy boots with light-blue kneecaps; tiny silver fasteners. A short deep-blue shoulder mantle attached securely at the back, ends above the thigh; no long cape, no helmet, no scarf covering his face. Greatly REDUCE brown: no brown leather boots/belts/coat; use deep blue and light blue with silver. His hair is one solid muted blue, NO hair highlights; cloth/armor matte with restrained plane shadows, no glossy surface shine. Limited crisp pixel clusters, exactly the readable 4x NES/JRPG remake sprite style of Image1, not a painted illustration or 3D model.
LEFT sprite: relaxed strong left-facing sword-and-shield stance, same pose as Image1 slot31. Foreground hand holds ONE long sword diagonally down-left, rear arm holds one compact navy kite shield close to the right-side hip. Sword matches Image2: narrow silver angular hollow/openwork blade frame enclosing a blue patterned central spine, pointed long tip, circular deep-blue gem at crossguard, dark silver open geometric pommel, short blue feather/ribbon hanging from guard. Silver/blue sword must remain legible at small sprite scale. NO other sword, no magic beam, no detached weapon. Shield is navy with pale-blue rim, no new shield power.
RIGHT sprite: same man and EXACT SAME promoted armor, head/face/hair/shoulder/boots design and body scale, facing LEFT, standing fully drawing ONE recurve BOW toward the left with one nocked physical arrow. Sword and shield are NOT held in this sprite. Bow is deep navy with pale-blue limb inlays and a taut visible thin string; no brown wood, no magical projectiles. Foreground bow arm extends left, rear drawing hand at cheek, string pulled back to hand and arrow aligned left. One physical arrow only.
Both figures whole, generous transparent margins and gutter, fixed floor, same head/body proportions. Pixel palette: navy #172638 outline, #263c64 deep-blue cloth, #3976a8 blue cloth, #a7d7e5 light-blue armor, #e4e5df pale accents, #d7a27c tan skin, #a6776a skin shadow, #205b96 solid hair, #b9c5d1 silver metal, #4366b9 gem/feather. No brown costume, no gold trim overload, no hair glints, no text, no labels, no background, no large glow/halo, no extra objects.
